text.p: These are some of the leading stories in Syrian newspapers on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
SYRIA TIMES
- Iranian Foreign Minister Velayati in Damascus with message for president.
- Vice-President Khaddam confers with Finland minister on Middle East peace, bilateral ties.
President congratulates on Romanian national day.
- Jordanians voice absolute rejection of Israeli exhibition.
- Egyptian President Mubarak in Tripoli for talks with Gaddafi.
- Egyptian Foreign Minister Moussa hopes for balanced peace.
- French President Chirac tells Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to stick to land-for-peace principle.
- Netanyahu endorses settlement building in Jordan Valley.
- Gazan women call for release of detainees.
TISHREEN
- Jews fought with Hitler
- Iraq starts oil exports within days.
- Israel shells south Lebanon.
AL-THAWRA
- Assistant secretary-general of Al-Baath party Al-Ahmar says Israel does not want peace.
- Lebanese prime minister reiterates commitment to peace process.
AL-BAATH
- New round of Israeli-Palestinian talks leads to nothing.
- Jewish officers fought with the Nazis.
- Jordan's popular opposition to Israel grows. Trade unions call boycott of Israeli trade fair and to stop normalisation.
